title: fix: rollback autoscaler burst util reporting spike
author: Maya Thompson
description: After a recent rollback of an autoscaler rollout (ENG-1876) customers observed transient spikes in the Dedicated fleet 'burst_utilization' metrics. Root cause: the rollback path left the tokenbucket/kv-state in a partially-updated state so reporting aggregated a single large delta which surfaced as a spike in telemetry and alerting. This PR adds a targeted fix that resets the in-memory tokenbucket deltas on rollback and adds a telemetry guard to prevent emitting spurious high deltas while the controller drains outstanding tokens. The change is narrowly scoped to the rollback + reporting codepaths to minimize risk to steady-state autoscaling behavior. Checklist: 1) confirm tokenbucket state reset on rollback; 2) add unit and integration tests covering rollback->reporting sequence; 3) add telemetry guard with defensive early-return when metrics delta exceeds configured threshold; 4) update docs to clarify metric semantics around rollbacks. Testing performed: local unit tests, autoscaler integration tests (simulated rollbacks), and an e2e dry-run on a staging Dedicated fleet. Linked: SUP-2219 for customer report, ENG-1876 for follow-up autoscaler improvements. Notes: this PR intentionally does not change batching or throughput guarantees; it only affects reporting surface and telemetry emission to avoid alert noise. Merge plan: squash+merge after CI green and two approvals. Rollback plan: revert commit and restore previous telemetry guard toggle; metric spike would be restored to previous behavior but no state corruption.
commits: chore(autoscaler): add telemetry guard feature flag
fix(autoscaler): reset tokenbucket deltas during rollback
review_comments: Alex Chen: Please add a unit test that asserts the tokenbucket reset; otherwise lgtm.

merge_commit_message:
fix(autoscaler): reset tokenbucket deltas on rollback and add telemetry guard to prevent spurious burst util spikes

Resolves ENG-1876, addresses SUP-2219. Adds tests and docs.
release_notes:
- Fix: avoid transient spike in Dedicated 'burst_utilization' metrics when an autoscaler rollback occurs.
- Add: telemetry guard and unit/integration tests for rollback reporting behavior.
notes_for_ops: Operators: the telemetry guard is behind the 'autoscaler.telemetry.rollback_guard' flag in telemetry_config.yaml. Default enabled in staging and prod for this rollout. If you need to revert quickly, revert the PR and toggle the feature flag off; metric emission returns to prior behavior but will reintroduce alert noise until tokenbucket state naturally drains.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: incorrect tokenbucket reset could affect short-lived snapshots of utilization. Mitigation: conservative reset that only zeroes transient delta counters (not persisted capacity state); unit tests + integration e2e validated behavior under heavy rollback/reapply cycles.
